problem:
Consider the matrices

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}4 & 7 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}2 & -7 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 4 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 5\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -3 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

- $AB=BA={I}_{4}$
- $AC=CA={I}_{4}$
- $C={A}^{-1}$
